title: Deepening Our Commitment to Los Angeles: Netflix Purchases Radford Studio Center
summary: Today, we’re proud to share that Netflix is purchasing Radford Studio Center to strengthen our investment in Los Angeles and California.
body_markdown:
Unless you work in entertainment or live in Los Angeles, you may not have heard of Radford Studio Center. But you’ve probably seen something that was made there.


Opened in 1928, at the end of the silent film era, Radford has been home to a long list of classic shows — from


Gunsmoke


and


Gilligan's Island


to


The Mary Tyler Moore Show


,


Seinfeld


, and


That ‘70s Show


, among many, many others.


Today, we’re proud to share that Netflix is purchasing Radford to build on that history and strengthen our investment in Los Angeles and California.


Netflix was founded in California, and we opened our first office in LA more than two decades ago. Since then, many of our shows like early favorites


Grace and Frankie


and


GLOW


have filmed in L.A., as have more recent series and films like


Nobody Wants This


,


The Lincoln Lawyer,


The Rip


and


The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.


This year alone, more than 45 of our shows and movies are confirmed to film across L.A.


We’ve also engaged ZVantage, Zello’s entertainment advisory division, to support the transition and next chapter of the iconic lot through its operating platform, Backlot Studio Services. As part of the engagement, Cinelease will serve as a production equipment provider at the studio, further enhancing the infrastructure and services available to the production community. Working together, our goal is to maintain operational continuity, retain the existing studio team and strengthen Radford’s position as a premier production destination.


There’s still a long way to go, but we are hopeful that with the partnership of the State of California and the City of Los Angeles, this will be the start of a meaningful new investment in California's film industry.


This city is home to us. We’re excited to keep investing here and finding more ways to entertain the world, while supporting the writers, builders, electricians, drivers, designers, and talent who make LA, California, and the entertainment industry so special.
